qa.method: round trip: every written atlas, Aseprite JSON, SpriteFrames .tres, scene .tscn and Sprite3D contract was parsed back and compared with the source frames (exact RGBA), integer durations, loop flags, events and the shared anchor
notProven: Imports into the Aseprite, Godot 4, Phaser, PixiJS and Unity editors or runtimes were not run; only parse-level round trips were checked.
Engine import settings (filter, compression, mipmaps) are not written; set them as engine-export.md describes.
Animation quality, timing feel and silhouette consistency are not judged.

provenance.body_processing: Appearance edit of each complete original pose using one shared master. Fixed cell384x256 crop at32px row inset, alpha128 threshold. No per-pose registration/resize, no anatomical part cutting/warping.
provenance.animation_constraint: Preserve61 frame references,8 clips, frame order, ticks, events, states, loops, anchor and independent sonic FX contract. Appearance-only; source pose preservation requires visual comparison.
provenance.timing_fix: Export automatic tick basis at60Hz, not rounded integer-ms fixedFPS. Authored ticks unchanged.
